messages.label: Attach; explore visually
messages.note: gc session attach <session-id-or-alias>. PM writes shared Archify JSON IR, renders that exact revision to HTML, and adds a supplementary summary. The architect can lead symmetrically; both agents read Hindsight context. For a lightweight question instead, use gc mail send <target> -s <subject> -m <question> and reply by mail. Optional --notify requests a turn or managed wake; mail is not assigned review work.

messages.label: Sling tracked review bead
messages.note: Create the review work bead first, with shared artifact paths, IR revision and completion criteria; gc sling routes that existing bead to the architect. Sling alone does not automatically resume PM on completion. Agent addresses depend on import bindings; workflow routing is proposed, not configured.

messages.label: Route review work
messages.note: Architect reads the shared exploration and writes a persisted review artifact with verdict, findings and any errors.

messages.label: Register wait; yield
messages.note: gc session wait "$GC_SESSION_ID" --on-beads "$REVIEW" --note "Review completed; inspect verdict and artifact" --sleep. Confirm registration succeeds, then yield. Registration checks an already-closed dependency immediately. --sleep is optional and requires a running managed controller; without it, an active session receives the completion notification without sleeping. The durable wait is tied to the continuation epoch. Explicit wake/resume/reset can cancel a stale wait; recovered PM rereads the bead and re-registers if needed.

messages.label: Complete bead + result path
messages.note: Persist the review verdict and artifact path before completing the bead. Optional mail is only a brief pointer; it is not the chosen completion mechanism.

messages.label: Completion nudge; resume PM
messages.note: The controller reconciles the durable wait, queues a completion nudge and resumes the managed PM. No agent polling loop. The notification means the watched bead closed, not that the review approved the design. Wait state, work beads and artifacts remain authoritative; the nudge is only a notification.

messages.label: Read verdict + artifact
messages.note: After notification, PM rereads the completed bead, checks verdict and errors, and reads the persisted review at its recorded path. Missing or failed results require resolution; closure alone is not approval. After an explicit wake/resume/reset, reread the bead and re-register a canceled wait if still needed.

messages.label: Revised IR as HTML + summary
messages.note: PM resolves review findings in the JSON IR, renders that exact revised JSON to HTML, and updates the supplementary summary. The human reviews this HTML rendering, not a separately authored interpretation.

messages.label: Approve exact IR revision
messages.note: Approval binds the JSON IR revision represented by the reviewed HTML. If the IR changes, render and review the new revision before using it as approved input.

messages.label: Generate once; then refine
messages.note: gc sling <target> <formula> --formula; use configured binding-specific targets. Supply the approved JSON IR revision as primary input plus its supplementary summary, which cannot override it. Generate PRD by PM, HLD/needed ADRs by architect, specs in successive joint steps, once per initiative. ALWAYS enter the same reusable refinement used for every later substantive edit, even without a supplied change. Assess whole-set impact, alignment and completeness; justify corrections or propose separate candidate IR; revise affected docs; assign distinct cross-review with PM product and architect technical lenses across the whole set, one writer at a time. No third reviewer persona by default; session isolation is not committed. Live candidate/docs edits during discussion remain drafts until shared review passes. Only justified required findings block completion; return unresolved decisions to human or mark the exact revision ready for approval. Substantive edits invalidate readiness. Preserve original approved IR immutable; human approval of exact rendered candidate promotes baseline, then reconcile affected docs. Candidate approval is separate from final spec authorization and build dispatch. Pinned Archify compare is architecture-only; workflow/sequence/dataflow use separate before/after renders plus change summary. All JSON/HTML and diff evidence stay outside Hindsight. Draft discussions/docs and decision prose can publish throughout refinement via existing Hindsight; approval is independent of ingestion. Formula ends in persistent human approval queue for later batches across sessions/initiatives; accepted status republishes same IDs and releases native builds. Reports compare built vs. spec, deviations and why, including partial/blocked outcomes, and ship via existing Hindsight. Native gc.run_target routing and formula dependencies handle internal steps; do not manually sling or register waits for each. No new orchestrator. Apply the cost/stop rule to workflow recommendations too; existing requirements bind unless human changes scope.

cards.title: Mail or tracked review
items: Lightweight question and reply use durable mail, not assigned work. --notify optionally requests a turn.
Tracked review uses a work bead + session wait. Sling alone does not resume PM; GC notifies without agent polling.
These are separate example requests, not a mandatory pair. Either PM or architect can lead.

cards.title: No third coordinator
items: GC routes and reconciles waits. Persisted artifacts, work beads and wait state are authoritative, not mail or nudges.
Completion means closed, not approved. PM reads verdict, artifact path and errors before revising.
Waits follow the continuation epoch. After wake/resume/reset, reread the bead and re-register if needed.

cards.title: Shared refinement, bounded review
items: Generate once; initial set and later edits share assessment, revision, distinct PM + architect review. One writer; no default third reviewer. Exact-revision readiness.
Credible omission cost vs. complexity, delay, maintenance. Only justified required findings block, not hypotheticals. Full cost/stop and approval rules: final message note + README.
